description_en: Queries the backup list of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) cluster instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群实例的备份列表
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-cluster-backup-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id r-t4nj72oug5r5646qog --start-time 2024-06-28T08:26Z --end-time 2024-07-01T09:26Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClusterBackupList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values:

30
50
100
200
300
5
10
15
20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to show backup set information for shards in the instance.

true: does not show backup set information for shards in the instance.
false (default): shows backup set information for shards in the instance.

Valid values:

True
False
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示集群节点的备份集详情：
false（默认）：展示集群节点的备份集信息。
true：不展示集群节点的备份集信息
parameters.name: no_shard_backup

ClusterBackups.description_en: The backup sets of the instance. A backup contains the backup sets of all shards in the instance
ClusterBackups.description_zh: 集群备份集列表，一个集群备份里面包含各个节点的备份集

items.description_en: The backup set of the instance. A backup contains the backup sets of all shards in the instance
items.description_zh: 集群备份集列表，一个集群备份里面包含各个节点的备份集

Backups.description_en: The backup sets of all shards in the instance
Backups.description_zh: 单个集群备份集下，各个子节点的备份集集合

BackupDownloadURL.description_en: The public download URL of the backup file
BackupDownloadURL.description_zh: 备份文件的外网下载地址

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the backup file

BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_en:
The internal download URL of the backup file.

You can use this URL to download the backup file from an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance that is connected to the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. The ECS instance must reside in the same virtual private cloud (VPC) as the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
BackupIntranetDownloadURL.description_zh:
备份文件的内网下载地址。

您可以在与该实例连通的ECS（二者需属于同一VPC内）上使用该地址下载目标备份文件

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup. Valid values:

OK
ERROR
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态，返回值：
OK：成功。
ERROR：失败

Engine.description_en: The database engine. The return value is redis

IsAvail.description_en:

0: unavailable
1: available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，取值说明：
0：不可用。
1：可用

RecoverConfigMode.description_en: This parameter does not take effect. Ignore this parameter
RecoverConfigMode.description_zh: 该参数暂未生效，请忽略该参数

FreeSize.description_zh:
<props="china">该实例的免费备份额度，单位是字节，免费额度为实例规格默认内存量，更多信息请参见备份商业化通知。 全量备份和日志备份共享该免费额度。当变配实例规格时，实例的免费额度会产生变化。</props>

FullStorageSize.description_en:
The size of the full backup file of the instance. Unit: bytes. Full backups originate from scheduled backups, manual backups, and backups generated during cache analysis.

The value of this parameter is independent of the number and size of returned backup sets. Instead, it represents the size of all valid full backups of the instance
FullStorageSize.description_zh:
当前实例全量备份文件的大小，单位是字节。全量备份来源于每天定时备份、手动备份、缓存分析时生成的备份等。
该值和当前请求所响应的备份集数量以及大小无关，而是该实例当前所有有效全量备份的大小
FullStorageSize.title_en: 当前实例全量备份大小
FullStorageSize.title_zh: 当前实例全量备份大小

LogStorageSize.description_en:
The size of the log backup file of the instance. Unit: bytes. This parameter is valid only when flashback is enabled.

The value of this parameter is independent of the number and size of returned backup sets. Instead, it represents the size of all valid log backups of the instance
LogStorageSize.description_zh:
当前实例日志备份文件的大小，单位是字节，当且仅当开启闪回时才有效。
该值和当前请求所响应的备份集数量以及大小无关，而是该实例当前所有有效日志备份的大小
LogStorageSize.title_en: 当前实例日志备份大小
LogStorageSize.title_zh: 当前实例日志备份大小
